Thanks for the heads up, Sergio. Quick answers below — sharing here so IT can confirm: 

1) Outbound IPs: demo sessions originate from our hosted region in us-west-2. The IP range to allowlist is 54.201.0.0/16 and 3.239.0.0/16. (If you need CIDR exceptions, let us know and we can provide a smaller set for the exact hour.)
2) Inbound ports: no inbound ports are required for the demo. All traffic is outbound from our environment during the interactive walkthrough.
3) Network dependencies: customer may need to allow TLS to redwood-inference.com and redwood-media-cdn.com.

Marissa and I can run a 30–45 minute demo followed by an optional 30-minute technical deep-dive if you want Karthik to show integration points.

Marissa — I tentatively blocked Dec 7 09:30–10:30 PST and Dec 8 09:30–10:30 PST on my calendar. Sergio — can you confirm which day/time works best? Alternatively, book here: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min?cid=orb-342
